configuration.enableHookDetection.descri:
Enable hook-based session state detection (thinking/waiting/idle).  
When enabled, this extension:  
- Writes hook entries to `~/.claude/settings.local.json`  
- Copies a Node.js script to `~/.claude/hooks/`  

All changes are **automatically removed** when disabled.  
Requires **Node.js** in PATH. New Claude Code sessions must be started after toggling.
